text.p: German airline Eurowings Luftverkehrs AG said it launched a code-share flight with British carrier Gill Airways from Duesseldorf to Belfast on Monday.

Gill Airways will fly under a joint code five days a week at 10:00 local (10.00 GMT) from the Northern Irish capital via Newcastle to Duesseldorf with a return flight at 16:20 local (15.30 GMT) a Eurowings statement said.
The two airlines started a code-share service between Duesseldorf and Newcastle in September under which Gill Airways took over the previous Eurowings route.
Eurowings marketing director Ulrich Sigmann said: "The first months of our co-operation on the route between Duesseldorf and Newcastle have been very successful.

"In accordance with demand and the wishes of our passengers, Eurowings and Gill Airways are now linking Duesseldorf with Belfast," he added. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
